en: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.
zh: 傳說很久以前，有一位美麗的女子叫做嫦娥。
ja: 伝説によると、遠い昔、嫦娥という美しい女性がいました。
local: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.
native: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.

en: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.
zh: 她的丈夫后羿是一位出色的弓箭手。
ja: 彼女の夫、后羿は優れた射手でした。
local: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.
native: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.

en: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in
zh: 當時天空中有十個太陽，地上的人們生活在
ja: その時、空には十人の太陽がいて、地上の人々は
local: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in
native: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in

en: a blistering heat.
zh: 酷熱之中。
ja: 猛烈な暑さの中で暮らしていました。
local: a blistering heat.
native: a blistering heat.

en: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.
zh: 為了拯救地球，后羿用弓箭射下了九個太陽。
ja: 地球を救うために、后羿は弓矢で九つの太陽を撃ち落としました。
local: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.
native: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.

en: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward
zh: 后羿被尊為民族英雄，並獲得了長生不老藥作為獎勵
ja: 后羿は国の英雄として尊敬され、不老不死の霊薬を報酬として受け取りました。
local: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward
native: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward

en: for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.
zh: 因為他拯救了人們免受多個太陽的酷熱。
ja: 多くの太陽の暑さから人々を救ったためです。
local: for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.
native: for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.

en: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want
zh: 然而，這瓶靈藥只能供一人服用，嫦娥和后羿都不願意
ja: しかし、その霊薬は一人分しかなく、嫦娥と后羿はどちらも
local: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want
native: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want

en: to lead each other.
zh: 彼此離開。
ja: お互いに離れたくありませんでした。
local: to lead each other.
native: to lead each other.

en: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.
zh: 但有一天，后羿不在家時，他的一位學生試圖偷取靈藥。
ja: しかしある日、后羿が不在の時に彼の弟子の一人が霊薬を盗もうとしました。
local: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.
native: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.

en: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.
zh: 為了保護靈藥不被小偷奪走，嫦娥服用了這瓶神奇的長生不老藥。
ja: 霊薬を盗人から守るために、嫦娥はその不老不死の霊薬を飲みました。
local: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.
native: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.

en: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.
zh: 然後她飛向月亮，成為月亮女神，留下了她的丈夫。
ja: そして彼女は月へ飛び、月の女神となり、夫を残していきました。
local: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.
native: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.

en: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and
zh: 后羿獨自留在地球上，非常思念妻子，於是向月亮獻上祭品，並
ja: 地上に一人残された后羿は妻をとても恋しがり、月に供え物をし、
local: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and
native: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and

en: tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.
zh: 試圖在月亮上尋找嫦娥的身影。
ja: 月の上に嫦娥の姿を探そうとしました。
local: tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.
native: tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.

en: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts
zh: 為了紀念嫦娥，中國人透過吃水果和月餅來祭拜月亮，
ja: 嫦娥を記念して、中国の人々は果物や月の形をしたお菓子を食べて月を崇拝します。
local: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts
native: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts

en: called mooncakes.
zh: 這些月餅。
ja: 月餅と呼ばれるものです。
local: called mooncakes.
native: called mooncakes.

en: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.
zh: 這就是中秋節的起源傳說，中秋節也被稱為月亮節。
ja: これが中秋節の起源の伝説で、中秋節は月の祭りとも呼ばれます。
local: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.
native: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.

en: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday
zh: 如今，中秋節同時也是一個豐收節，已成為家庭節日，
ja: 現在、中秋節は収穫祭でもあり、家族の休日となっています。
local: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday
native: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday

en: like Thanksgiving.
zh: 就像感恩節一樣。
ja: 感謝祭のようなものです。
local: like Thanksgiving.
native: like Thanksgiving.

en: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.
zh: 大多數人會和家人一起享用豐盛的晚餐來慶祝中秋節。
ja: 多くの人は家族と一緒に大きな夕食をとって中秋節を祝います。
local: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.
native: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.

en: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various
zh: 人們會賞月、送禮、旅行、觀賞燈籠展、品嚐各種
ja: 人々は月を見たり、贈り物をしたり、旅行したり、灯籠のショーを見たり、さまざまな
local: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various
native: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various

en: desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their
zh: 甜點，並放天燈祈求自己和家人的幸福。
ja: デザートを食べたり、ランタンを飛ばして自分や家族の幸せを祈ったりします。
local: desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their
native: desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their

en: families.
ja: 家族の幸せを祈ります。
local: families.
native: families.

en: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
zh: 研究嫦娥可以更深入了解中秋節。
ja: 嫦娥について調べることで中秋節についてもっと知ることができます。
local: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
native: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
